title: Rounded cover, shelled

description.en: A cover moulded as one shell: outside 60 x 40 x 15 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z), every edge of the top and the four upright corners rounded with a 4 mm radius, the bottom edges left sharp, then hollowed to a 1.5 mm wall everywhere, open at the bottom (the face on the XY plane). Drive it by the variables length, width, height, radius and wall.
description.nl: Een kap, gegoten als één schaal: buitenmaat 60 x 40 x 15 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z), alle randen van de bovenkant en de vier staande hoeken afgerond met een straal van 4 mm, de onderranden scherp, en dan uitgehold tot een wand van 1,5 mm overal, open aan de onderkant (het vlak op het XY-vlak). Stuur hem met de variabelen length, width, height, radius en wall.

variables.name: radius
variables.meaning: outside radius of the rounded edges

derivation: Outside solid: a box L x W x H with the top and upright edges rounded by r. Write a = L - 2r, b = W - 2r. Below Z = H - r every section is a rounded rectangle, A0 = a b + 2 r (a + b) + pi r^2. At height s above H - r the section is the rectangle a x b grown by rho = sqrt(r^2 - s^2): a b + 2 rho (a + b) + pi rho^2; integrated over s from 0 to r it gives a b r + (pi/2) r^2 (a + b) + (2/3) pi r^3.
The hollow is the same shape for L - 2t, W - 2t, H - t and radius r - t (offset inward by t; a - and b - are unchanged), open at Z = 0. V = V(outside) - V(hollow).

Area of each shape without its bottom: walls (2 (a + b) + 2 pi r)(H - r), the flat top a b, the top fillets pi r (a + b) (quarter cylinders), the four corner balls 4 * (1/8) 4 pi r^2 = 2 pi r^2. Plus the ring left at the bottom, A0(outside) - A0(hollow).
Centroid Z from the moments: A0 (H - r)^2 / 2 for the prism part, and for the top part (H - r) V_top + int s (...) ds = a b r^2/2 + 2 (a + b) r^3/3 + pi r^4/4. X and Y by symmetry.
